Database Schema:
CREATE TABLE `airlines` (
  `uid` NUMBER,
  `Airline` TEXT,
  `Abbreviation` TEXT,
  `Country` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`uid`)
);

CREATE TABLE `airports` (
  `City` TEXT,
  `AirportCode` TEXT,
  `AirportName` TEXT,
  `Country` TEXT,
  `CountryAbbrev` TEXT,
  PRIMARY KEY (`AirportCode`)
);

  `Airline` NUMBER,
  `FlightNo` NUMBER,
  `SourceAirport` TEXT REFERENCES `airports`(`AirportCode`),
  `DestAirport` TEXT REFERENCES `airports`(`AirportCode`),

);
